title: Real induction on [0, L) for a right-open, left-closed property
statement: Let G be a predicate on ℝ and L ∈ ℝ. Assume (a) G(0); (b) for every φ with 0 ≤ φ < L and G(φ) there is ε > 0 such that G(ψ) holds for every ψ with φ < ψ < φ + ε; (c) for every φ with 0 < φ < L such that G(ψ) holds for every ψ with 0 ≤ ψ < φ, G(φ) holds. Then G(φ) holds for every φ with 0 ≤ φ < L.
lean_statement: ∀ (G : ℝ → Prop) (L : ℝ), G 0 → (∀ φ : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ → φ < L → G φ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ, φ < ψ → ψ < φ + ε → G ψ) → (∀ φ : ℝ, 0 < φ → φ < L → (∀ ψ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ψ → ψ < φ → G ψ) → G φ) → ∀ φ : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ → φ < L → G φ
